description: The settings.list happy path (S44 T5, the door the Settings UI T8 walks and the CLI T7 is a client of, P34): a list scoped to the "test" area returns every declared key in that area, each a full SettingView — the declaration (key/area/type/default/description/sensitive and the type's bounds) plus the EFFECTIVE value and the layer that won (source). A declared, never-written key answers its default with source="default" and stored=null; null is the honest "never set", which a bare absent field cannot say. The UI renders the list by area; the CLI lists the same rows (one protocol, N projections).
